notes: Downloadable-font coverage-preserving approximation of a dense engraving. Potrace 1.16 tolerance 0.35 and 1/64-unit coordinates retain the original frame and advance. Screening is a modern font-format interpretation, not historical engraved linework. Full-detail master and SVG remain unchanged; all downloadable fonts use this reviewed drawing; see the display-size comparison proof.
